description: This file defines a configuration class for the DALL-E 2 image editing API, including methods to transform image edit requests specific to DALL-E 2's API requirements. It deals with request parameter handling, including image and mask processing, and validates constraints such as only supporting a single image per request.

classes.name: DallE2ImageEditConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for DALL-E 2 image editing API, extending OpenAIImageEditConfig and customizing request transformation for image edits.

methods.description: Transforms parameters into the specific request format for DALL-E-2, including validation of a single image and processing of optional mask data.
